Name: IS' Recolored Mushroom Trees
Author: Irkensnacks
Description:
I love the red mushroom trees but I noticed there aren't any recolors of them, so I made these for people who'd like something different than the red cap. There's only 3 colors for now, but I plan on adding add more colors in the near future. (yellow, orange, pink, etc)

To use:
Content Patcher: Drag the [CP] Mushroom Tree Replacement folder (with the color you want) into your Mods folder.
To change the shape of the tree, open the content.JSON file and change "FromFile": "assets/mush_alternate.png" to "FromFile": "assets/mush_vanilla.png"
Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.

XNB: Replace the mushroom_tree.xnb file in the Stardew Valley>Content>TerrainFeatures folder with the .xnb file of the color you'd like to use. I still need to update these.
Requires tampering with base game files. Always have back-ups!

[b]Please note that I only recolored the curved trees due to a request. If any of the original creators want their content removed, [u]I will happily do so[/u]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5924596]Enginemeister[/url] created the CP version of the original curved mushroom tree mods, which were created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1245918]burtron[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/49592441]allanbachti[/url]. All credit goes to them!
[/b]
Check out their individual mods here:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2392][CP] Mushroom Tree Replacement
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1729]Mushroom Tree Re-texture
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/338?tab=description]Mushroom Tree Growth Re-texture[/url]﻿

I'm still a noob when it comes to this stuff so if there are any issues please let me know right away and I'll fix them.
Anyways, enjoy!
